## Summary
Build the faculty item review interface with an item card showing stem/key/distractors, a component editor for inline edits, and a Toulmin panel displaying the structured argumentation chain for each answer option.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to review generated items with full visibility into the reasoning behind each answer option, and be able to edit any component inline, so that I can efficiently approve high-quality items and improve borderline ones.

## Why this matters
Faculty review is the quality gate before items enter the practice pool. If the review UI is slow, confusing, or doesn't surface enough information, faculty waste time or approve low-quality items. The Toulmin panel is critical for trust -- faculty need to see the structured reasoning to verify clinical accuracy without reconstructing it themselves. The component editor enables quick fixes instead of full rejection + regeneration (which costs $0.12/item).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Item review page at `/items/[id]` shows full item with all components
- [ ] ItemReviewCard displays: stem, lead-in, key, 3 distractors, Bloom level, difficulty band, QA score
- [ ] QA score visually highlighted: green >= 80, yellow 60-79, red < 60
- [ ] ToulminPanel shows 6-component chain (Claim, Data, Warrant, Backing, Qualifier, Rebuttal) for key and each distractor
- [ ] Toulmin panel is collapsible per answer option
- [ ] ComponentEditor allows inline editing of: stem, lead-in, key text, distractor text, rationale text
- [ ] Edits save to Supabase via API (not direct DB call from component)
- [ ] Approve/Reject buttons emit `journey/items.batch-reviewed` event (consumed by E05-S09)
- [ ] Batch review: faculty can approve/reject multiple items from list view
- [ ] Provenance metadata visible: context sources, generation cost, model versions, critique notes
- [ ] Responsive layout (desktop-first, functional on tablet)
- [ ] Loading states and optimistic updates for edits

## API contract
```
GET /api/generation/items/[id]
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response: {
  data: {
    id: string,
    stem: string,
    lead_in: string,
    key_answer: string,
    distractors: [{ text, misconception_category_id, rationale }],
    rationale: { key: ToulminChain, distractors: ToulminChain[] },
    bloom_level: string,
    difficulty_band: string,
    qa_score: QAScore,
    provenance: Provenance,
    status: string
  },
  error: null
}

PATCH /api/generation/items/[id]
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: { field: string, value: string } (partial update)
Response: { data: { id: string, updated_at: string }, error: null }

POST /api/generation/review
(same as E05-S09 API contract)
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// app/(faculty)/items/[id]/page.tsx — MUST be < 30 lines
import { ItemReviewContainer } from '@/features/item-generation';

export default async function ItemReviewPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  return <ItemReviewContainer itemId={params.id} />;
}

// features/item-generation/components/ToulminPanel.tsx
interface ToulminPanelProps {
  chain: ToulminChain;
  label: string; // "Key" or "Distractor A/B/C"
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
}

export function ToulminPanel({ chain, label, defaultOpen = false }: ToulminPanelProps) {
  return (
    <Collapsible defaultOpen={defaultOpen}>
      <CollapsibleTrigger>{label}</CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <ToulminField label="Claim" value={chain.claim} />
          <ToulminField label="Data" value={chain.data} />
          <ToulminField label="Warrant" value={chain.warrant} />
          <ToulminField label="Backing" value={chain.backing} />
          <ToulminField label="Qualifier" value={chain.qualifier} />
          <ToulminField label="Rebuttal" value={chain.rebuttal} />
        </div>
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}

// features/item-generation/components/ComponentEditor.tsx
interface ComponentEditorProps {
  itemId: string;
  field: string;
  value: string;
  onSave: (newValue: string) => Promise<void>;
}

export function ComponentEditor({ itemId, field, value, onSave }: ComponentEditorProps) {
  // Inline edit with optimistic update
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright -- runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E05/E05-S10.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Item review page renders all components', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/items/test-item-id');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="item-review-card"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="stem"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="key-answer"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="distractor-0"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="distractor-1"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="distractor-2"]')).toBeVisible();
});

test('Toulmin panel shows all 6 components', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/items/test-item-id');
  await page.click('[data-testid="toulmin-trigger-key"]');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="toulmin-claim"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="toulmin-data"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="toulmin-warrant"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="toulmin-backing"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="toulmin-qualifier"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="toulmin-rebuttal"]')).toBeVisible();
});

test('Component editor saves inline edits', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/items/test-item-id');
  await page.click('[data-testid="edit-stem"]');
  await page.fill('[data-testid="stem-editor"]', 'Updated stem text');
  await page.click('[data-testid="save-stem"]');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="stem"]')).toContainText('Updated stem text');
});

test('QA score color coding: red < 60, yellow 60-79, green >= 80', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/items/test-item-low-qa');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="qa-score"]')).toHaveClass(/red/);
});

test('Approve/Reject buttons visible', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/items/test-item-id');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="approve-btn"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="reject-btn"]')).toBeVisible();
});
```
